Management request helper.
 *
 * `signOutOn401` decides whether a 401 should drop the whole console session. By default it does (the management session really did expire),
 * but a 401 from the feedback page means "GitHub sign-in expired", not "management session expired" — in that case kicking the user to the login page would
 * lose the feedback text they have already written, whereas reconnecting GitHub only takes one click on the page.
// 状态码随错误一起抛出:调用方需要区分\"管理会话过期\"(401) 与普通: // The status code is thrown together with the error: callers need to tell an "expired management session" (401) apart from an ordinary failure.
